circuitBreakerTrigger.costBasis: Circuit breaker summed estimated_cost_usd across 21 tasks — not actual spend. This is a false alarm: real spend was $0.52 (two QC reviews).

investigation.rootCause: uc-leadflow-maintenance is a kitchen-sink catch-all that accumulated tasks from 4 distinct sources over 6 weeks: (1) manual human-created backlog items for operator tasks, (2) auto-generated 'Improve: uc_no_tasks' tasks from the genome, (3) QC reviews that should reference their own UCs, (4) a now-completed backlog audit. No single deliverable or acceptance criterion ties these together.
